visual_group_scope: Avoid competing labels for overlapping shared CJK designs. Only recorded Noto binaries are sampled here; not a claim that all versions, scripts, metrics or files are identical.
download_attempt_note: One redundant IBM package LICENSE download collided by filename case on macOS; downloaded separately as package-LICENSE.txt. The actual font license.txt was present and verified throughout.

excluded_sources.Klee One: LXGW WenKai derives from Klee; do not use as an independent unknown family.
excluded_sources.Droid Sans Fallback: Potential shared outlines with known WenQuanYi Micro Hei; not selected.
excluded_sources.LXGW WenKai Mono: Same design family as known LXGW WenKai; not selected.

coverage_scope: IBM Plex Sans SC covers all GB2312 Han; M PLUS 1p, Yusei Magic and Yuji Syuku are Japanese CJK fonts with partial GB2312 coverage. Scene generation must use actual per-face cmap; Latin-only unknown fonts never receive Han text.
independence_scope: New CAL/TEST source families/files are absent from the first Android registry and new TRAIN registry. This does not independently audit every initialization pretraining source.
